# Q* superpixels (vendored source)

This directory contains the source package supplied by Marius Aasan in
`new_spx-main.zip`, imported unchanged except for this wrapper README.  It is
used by `yolo_superpixels.superpixels.qstar` and remains under the upstream MIT
license in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The project intentionally vendors source rather than requiring an unpinned
external checkout.  [PROVENANCE.md](PROVENANCE.md) and
[UPSTREAM_README.md](UPSTREAM_README.md) retain the supplied provenance and
documentation.  The example notebook, images, and upstream tests are omitted
because they are not runtime dependencies of this repository.
